I need to choose if Moonblast can likely score an OHKO against Incineroar. At around 65% health and between 110-131 HP, Primarina's Special Attack (with fairy STAB) indicates it could deal about 90-110% damage at level 50. Overall, I'm leaning towards choosing Moonblast for this matchup, as it seems slightly stronger.
